saw_lines: Teams buy branded merch in batches, and the person placing the order is the one who gets asked when it arrives.
So the sale is won or lost before the click, when the ad answers shipping and offer questions in line one.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 8 live ads mention it or any offer. Put it in line one of three new ads and on the creative.
ads_1: Three new ads opening on the first order discount and a plain shipping answer
